note: Bits farmed from other morning shows, rewritten as JB & Sandy Austin versions. Items older than 7 days drop to the archive. Newest first.

items.title: Christmas card of just you (or just you and the dog)
items.how: They debate whether it is weird to send out a Christmas card that is only you, or only you and your pet.
items.ours: JB and Sandy rule on it, Tricia brings the receipts from cards we got. Phones: what is the weirdest Christmas card you ever got in Austin?

items.title: Halloween decorating is the new side hustle
items.how: Story that people are now getting paid to decorate other folks' houses for Halloween, plus a phone-battery overcharging warning.
items.ours: Would you pay someone to do your yard, and what would you charge? Phones: Austin, who has the over-the-top Halloween house on your street?

items.title: Worst date: the hard kisser
items.how: A listener calls in to describe a date who was way too hard of a kisser.
items.ours: Keep it PG: what is the one move on a first date that ended it for you instantly? Phones open, Tricia scores the calls.

items.title: Awkward Thursday Phone Call: HOA vs. the Candy King
items.how: A caller's HOA is threatening to fine him hundreds of dollars if he goes through with his favorite Halloween tradition, so the show calls on his behalf.
items.ours: Austin HOA horror stories for Halloween week. Phones: what did your HOA try to fine you for, and did you fight it?

items.title: Kev won't let Anna drive his truck
items.how: Anna asks to drive Kevin's F-150, he hesitates, and it turns into a debate about who is the worst driver on the show.
items.ours: Who is the worst driver among JB, Sandy and Tricia? We each make the case. Phones: who in your family is never allowed to drive your truck?

items.title: Airbnb is banning unreasonable checkout chores
items.how: News that Airbnb is cracking down on hosts who pile chores on guests at checkout, opened up to texts and calls.
items.ours: Lake Travis and Fredericksburg rental stories. Phones: what is the most ridiculous checkout chore a rental ever made you do?

items.title: 5 @ 6:55: going for 15 in a row
items.how: Daily five-question trivia game; a listener on a 14-win streak goes head to head against co-host Shannon.
items.ours: A five-question KVET country trivia game where a caller tries to beat Tricia, with a running win streak. Phones: who thinks they can take her?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Her waiter boyfriend got a $1,000 tip from a smitten customer
items.how: The guys debate how a woman reacted after finding out a customer who had a crush on her waiter boyfriend tipped him $1,000.
items.ours: Do you let him keep it, or is that crush money? Phones: what is the biggest tip you ever got (or gave), and what was the story?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: What would your three wishes be?
items.how: Sherri Shepherd, Broadway's first female genie in Aladdin, joins and the show gets into everyone's three wishes.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each get three wishes, no wishing for more wishes. Phones: Austin, what is your first wish and why?

items.title: Amputate it or stitch it to your side?
items.how: Hypothetical question to the room: lose your arm, or have it stitched to your side for two months?
items.ours: JB and Sandy each pick and defend it, Tricia breaks the tie. Phones: which one, and what would you miss doing most?

items.title: KiddNation Confession: what happened to Mom's car
items.how: A listener finally confesses what really happened to his mom's car years ago.
items.ours: Austin Confession Booth: what did you do to a parent's car that they still don't know about? Phones open, statute of limitations applies.

items.title: Baby talk to your dog is good for it
items.how: Study says talking to your dog in a baby voice is actually beneficial; the room admits their dog voices.
items.ours: Sandy and JB do their pet voices on air. Phones: call in and do the voice you use with your dog (or cat).

items.title: A co-host's grandpa calls with a question
items.how: A cast member's grandfather calls in and puts another host on the spot with an interesting question.
items.ours: Get Tricia's or JB's relative on the phone to ask Sandy one question, unscreened. Phones: what question does your grandparent always ask?

items.title: Dumbest way you got hurt
items.how: A co-host is on a scooter after a self-inflicted injury and has to explain how it happened.
items.ours: Each of us shares our dumbest self-inflicted injury. Phones: how did you hurt yourself doing something stupid?

items.title: What's On Your Mind: the Early Birds club
items.how: Around-the-room segment: Brooke tried an 'Early Birds' club and loved it, Jeff ended up bartending on his birthday.
items.ours: We are early birds by trade. Phones: what's the earliest thing you do on purpose, and is anything in Austin worth getting up for?

items.title: Shock Collar Question
items.how: Quiz game where every question is about Doja Cat, Kim Kardashian or Judge Judy, with a penalty for wrong answers.
items.ours: Pop culture lightning round with a buzzer penalty (no actual shock): JB vs. Sandy, all questions about three random celebs Tricia picks.

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Paying for a seat at a stranger's wedding
items.how: Talk about a new platform that lets you pay to attend a stranger's wedding, plus who you would spend your last hour with.
items.ours: Would you pay to crash a Hill Country wedding, and how much? Phones: best wedding you went to where you barely knew the couple.

items.title: He who writes the check gets to dress the neck
items.how: Wedding etiquette fight: does whoever pays get to pick what the wedding party wears?
items.ours: Phones: if you pay for it, do you get a say? Weddings, family trips, kids' cars. JB and Sandy take opposite sides.

items.title: My smartwatch called 911
items.how: A host's smartwatch called 911 by accident and the show walks through the fallout.
items.ours: Phones: what did your tech do without asking? Watch called 911, car read a text out loud, Alexa ordered something.

items.title: What time should coffee shops open?
items.how: The show argues the right opening time for a coffee shop.
items.ours: We are on at 6. Name the Austin coffee spots that are not open yet when we are. Phones: what time should they open?

items.title: Today Years Old
items.how: Hosts reveal facts they only just learned and how old they were when they found out.
items.ours: JB and Sandy each confess one fact they learned embarrassingly late. Phones: how old were you?

items.title: Can you tickle yourself?
items.how: Light studio test and caller reactions about tickling yourself.
items.ours: Quick live test on air with JB. Short and silly, good for a tease.

items.title: Second Date Update: the Microwaved Salad Guy
items.how: Caller got ghosted after a first date. The show calls the date to find out why, and the reason is the punchline.
items.ours: Our version: Ghosted, Austin edition. Listener submits a date that went quiet, we call and find out. Phones: weirdest date habit you have seen.

items.title: Phone tap: the misspelled proposal fortune cookie
items.how: Prank call blaming a guy for the typo that turned his fiancee's name into Dennis.
items.ours: Not a prank (we skip those), but a phones topic: worst typo on something important, like a cake, a tattoo or a wedding invite.

items.title: Half your office is now her closet
items.how: Prank where a closet installer says the wife put a deposit down to turn half his office into her closet.
items.ours: Phones: who won the space war in your house? Garage, office or closet. Sandy and JB each pick a side.

pick.market: Indianapolis-based, syndicated on rock stations nationwide
pick.title: A refrigerator from the 1950s is still running
pick.how: A listener letter brags about a 1950s refrigerator that still works, and the crew riffs on old stuff that outlasts everything new.
pick.ours: Oldest thing in your house that still works. JB, Sandy and Tricia each name theirs. Phones: what's the oldest appliance or truck you're still using in Austin?
